tools.name: get_agent_action_review_service
tools.description: Find out how to get a 1 EURC second opinion before executing risky tool calls such as deleting files, publishing content, sending email or changing access. Returns an example, the purchase endpoint and the optional first-time setup path.

tools.name: read_agent_action_review
tools.description: Retrieve an existing report using the original private request ID. This tool is read-only and creates no new purchase.

tools.name: get_agent_action_review_checkout
tools.description: Find checkout options for a 1 EURC report. Direct Solana checkout combines the purchase and any required account setup in one buyer-signed transaction. The x402 route is also listed. This tool can prepare a setup-only draft with an authorized budget and never signs, broadcasts or charges anything.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_agent_action_review_service, read_agent_action_review, get_agent_action_review_checkout · Private data: get_agent_action_review_service, read_agent_action_review · Public sink: get_agent_action_review_service.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_agent_action_review_service, read_agent_action_review, get_agent_action_review_checkout · Private data: get_agent_action_review_service, read_agent_action_review · Public sink: get_agent_action_review_service

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
